chunks: This is the straight path of your Lord. Distinct have We made Our signs for those who reflect.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God's path is straight and His signs are detailed?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility) of the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt, who are viewed as the living embodiment of the straight path. The phrase 'detailed the signs' is interpreted not only as textual clarity but as the comprehensive guidance provided through the Imams, serving as a reminder for those who possess spiritual insight.
